title: Liquid Metal
description: Remap a live source into rippling chrome or mercury: luminance is pushed through a metallic light→dark→light sheen ramp, domain-warped by a slow flowing noise so the highlights slide like liquid, with a sharp specular glint riding each band's crest. Tint from chrome and steel to gold, copper or mercury; sheen bands, flow warp, speed, glint and contrast are live. Plates the camera, a dropped photo or clip, the demo, or the layers below in the Mixer/Patch.
